One busy clerk rotates unfinished print jobs around a circular service desk. Mina separates readings for the office's even-numbered keys. A zero reading belongs in that count, just like any other even number.

referenceSolutions.python:
def roundDeskEvenKeyCensus(readings, k):
    a=readings
    out=[]
    from collections import deque
    remaining=a[:]
    queue=deque(i for i,x in enumerate(a) if x>0)
    out=[0]*len(a)
    time=0
    while queue:
        i=queue.popleft()
        served=min(k,remaining[i])
        remaining[i]-=served
        time+=served
        if remaining[i]: queue.append(i)
        else: out[i]=time
    return sum(x%2==0 for x in out)
